title: Cold Day, Sunny Day
text:
Today is cold and rainy. I wear a warm coat, a hat and boots. My sister wears a red raincoat.

Tomorrow the sun will be out. We will not need our coats. I will wear a white shirt and shorts.

questions.text: What will the writer wear tomorrow?
Why will the writer probably not need a coat tomorrow?
How does the sister probably feel about today's weather?
options: She is happy to stay dry
She is bored of her clothes

vocabulary.definition: not warm; having a low temperature
a long piece of clothing worn outside to keep warm
shoes that cover the foot and part of the leg
the bright star that gives light and heat to the Earth

paragraph_translations: Hoje está frio e chovendo. Eu uso um casaco quente, um chapéu e botas. Minha irmã usa uma capa de chuva vermelha.
Amanhã o sol vai aparecer. Não vamos precisar dos nossos casacos. Eu vou usar uma camisa branca e shorts.
